::: proof

Entry-wise, for $i = 1, \ldots, p$:

$$
\ba
\left[\deriv{\vx} (\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b})\right]_i
&= \deriv{x_i} \sum_{k=1}^p a_k b_k \\
&= \sum_{k=1}^p \paren{b_k \deriv{x_i} a_k + a_k \deriv{x_i} b_k} \\
&= \left[\paren{\deriv{\vx} \tp{\mathbf{a}}}\mathbf{b}\right]_i
  + \left[\paren{\deriv{\vx} \tp{\mathbf{b}}}\mathbf{a}\right]_i
\ea
$$

:::
